brief: Goldman's derivatives desk reports poor sentiment and low net exposures have left investors hesitant to play offense, producing defensively tilted flows and steeper skew. Its Vol Panic Index reads only 2.7/10 even as gamma and implied vol screen cheap ahead of a catalyst heavy stretch of 3Q earnings, FOMC, and midterms, so Goldman expects clients to engage more tactically. Earnings season dispersion is priced richly: three month implied correlation sits below the 2nd percentile of the last twenty years. Generalist and long only outflows from AI and Memory names have coincided with unwinds of prior bullish option positions. Net exposure to Mag7 constituents is at the 100th percentile of the last five years even as their average three month implied volatility nears multi year lows, so Goldman likes Mag7 basket puts as a hedge through earnings and year end. Flows have also rotated into the Quality factor, now up 18% since mid August with exposure at 10 year highs. Separately, a multi day bid for duration, alongside GIR's view that yields are elevated versus fundamentals, positioning is underweight, and technical risks have faded, has drawn interest in rate sensitive relief trades.
